name: HYDRA-UMC-SYNTHETIC-DATA-GEN
notes: Real v0 procedural 2D scene generation, BMP and PNG rasterization with the standard library alone, and real YOLO/COCO annotation export (`generate` subcommand), verified end to end incl. visual inspection of a real rendered image. A real dataset manifest (manifest.json, with a reproducible-seed flag and a per-image sha256 checksum) and real post-generation validation (scene bounds, BMP integrity against a genuinely truncated file, label-distribution sanity) now run automatically at the end of every `generate` call. Honestly 2D placeholder shapes, not the photorealistic 3D rendering through HYDRA-UMC-TWIN's own engine - that engine doesn't exist yet (TWIN is itself still scaffolding). TFRecord export (`--tfrecord`) is in; real 3D rendering through TWIN is future work.
